title: Chantenum - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Chantenum in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Chantenum is a fire-element weapon used by Maelle. It scales with Agility (C), Luck (B).

sections.title: How to Get the Chantenum
sections.content:
Location: Sirene - merchant Klaudiso.

Obtained from Sirene - merchant Klaudiso.

sections.title: Is the Chantenum Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Agility (C), Luck (B). A dedicated fire pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
